_about: Domain ontology for GraphMind Research. Node labels and relationship types the pipeline may create, the closed vocabularies the LLM must choose from, and canonical metrics. Methods, datasets, papers and claims are discovered from the PDFs; they are NOT listed here.

node_labels.Paper: A document. in_library=true when its PDF was uploaded; false for a stub created from someone's reference list.
node_labels.Author: A person who wrote at least one paper (merged by normalised name).
node_labels.Institution: An affiliation as printed in a paper header.
node_labels.Venue: Conference, journal, workshop or preprint server.
node_labels.Method: A named technique or system. aliases[] holds every spelling seen; anchors[] holds ids of papers cited right next to a mention.
node_labels.Dataset: A named benchmark or corpus, with language and splits.
node_labels.Task: What a method or dataset is for.
node_labels.Result: One number from one table cell: value, split, origin, setting.
node_labels.Claim: A finding stated in a paper, in one sentence. Claims of type 'sota' carry scope = ['<dataset id>|<split>|<metric id>', ...] so they can be checked against results.
node_labels.Job: A unit of pipeline work shared between agents (status, stage, claimed_by).
node_labels.Workspace: Optional: one per user/team when all workspaces share one graph. Default design uses one FalkorDB graph per workspace.
node_labels.ResearchSession: A conversation/investigation; links to the questions asked and insights saved.
node_labels.Insight: A conclusion the user or agent saved, linked to the papers/claims it is about.

relationship_types.COAUTHOR: (Author)-[:COAUTHOR {papers, count}]->(Author), stored in both directions (FalkorDB algorithms follow edge direction)
relationship_types.EXTENDS: (Method)-[:EXTENDS]->(Method)   derived: proposing paper CITES the other paper with intent 'extends'
relationship_types.QUALIFIES: (Claim)-[:QUALIFIES {basis}]->(Claim)   the other claim only holds in a narrower scope
relationship_types.FOR_PAPER: (Job)-[:FOR_PAPER]->(Paper)   pipeline work item for one uploaded PDF

citation_intents.extends: builds directly on the cited method
citation_intents.compares_against: reports or quotes the cited work as a baseline
citation_intents.uses_dataset: evaluates on a dataset the cited work introduced
citation_intents.uses_method: uses the cited method or tool as a component
citation_intents.reproduces: re-runs the cited work to check its results
citation_intents.supports: presents evidence agreeing with the cited work
citation_intents.criticizes: argues the cited work is wrong or limited
citation_intents.corrects: erratum or correction of the cited work

result_origins.proposed: the paper's own method, run by the paper
result_origins.baseline_run: someone else's method, run by this paper
result_origins.quoted: number copied from another paper (source column cites it)
result_origins.reproduced: explicit reproduction of another paper's result
